_comment: Portable project MCP configuration for Claude Code, Kimi Code, and compatible clients

simple-mcp._info: Simple MCP server. 'bin/simple_mcp_server' is kept deliberately: it is the only spelling valid on BOTH platforms, and NO single string satisfies every spawn mechanism (measured 2026-09-01 on Windows 11, node v20.12.1 spawnSync matrix). Claude Code resolves the launcher itself and connects — 'claude mcp list' reported 'simple-mcp: bin/simple_mcp_server - OK Connected' on 4 of 5 runs (the one failure was a 7-server-at-once contention run, not the form), and this guard's own initialize handshake returns serverInfo.name=simple-mcp-full via PATHEXT resolution to bin\simple_mcp_server.cmd. A cmd.exe-mediated spawn (node shell:true, or node spawning a .cmd) rejects any forward-slash relative path with rc=1 "'bin' is not recognized as an internal or external command" — 'bin/simple_mcp_server' rc=1, 'bin/simple_mcp_server.cmd' rc=1, './bin/simple_mcp_server.cmd' rc=1; only 'bin\simple_mcp_server.cmd' works under BOTH node shell modes (rc=0, serverInfo), and that spelling is ENOENT on POSIX. Clients that spawn through cmd.exe must therefore use config/mcp/win/.mcp.json, which declares the backslash form. Verified by scripts/check/check-mcp-config-launchable.shs (spec: test/03_system/check/mcp_config_declared_command_launchable_spec.spl). Perf, measured 2026-09-01 on Windows: initialize round-trip 3.6s, init+tools/call 4.5-4.7s, peak RSS ~259 MB (interpreted via bin/release/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/simple.exe, md5 d52d770724a9f8797e98ac7819709ab9).

simple-lsp-mcp._info: Compiled Simple LSP MCP server via the cached native wrapper (hash-admitted + tools/call-probed). Same cross-platform launch constraint as simple-mcp above: the forward-slash form is kept because it is the only spelling valid on both platforms; cmd.exe-spawning clients must use config/mcp/win/.mcp.json. Measured 2026-09-01 on Windows: 'claude mcp list' reported 'OK Connected' on 5 of 5 runs, and the guard's initialize handshake returns serverInfo.name=simple-lsp-mcp via PATHEXT resolution to bin\simple_lsp_mcp_server.cmd. SIMPLE_EXECUTION_MODE=interpreter is load-bearing and is restored here after being dropped in an earlier edit: it is inherited by the query_visibility child, and dropping it regressed the lsp_symbols call from 3.68s to 7.96s. On Windows bin\simple_lsp_mcp_server.cmd also defaults it in its :source branch, so the two agree.

spipe._info: SPipe MCP — process/expert surfaces for the executable SSpec workflow (spipe_info, spipe_experts, spipe_read_doc, spipe_fine_tune_*, spipe). Pure node, no compiler dependency, so it is available before a bootstrap has produced bin/simple. Entry lives in the tracked examples/05_stdlib/spipe tree; .spipe/spipe_project is the host mount symlink to it.

stitch._info: Google Stitch MCP — UI design generation, site building, screen code retrieval
args: if [ -f ~/.security/env.sh ]; then . ~/.security/env.sh; fi; exec npx -y @_davideast/stitch-mcp proxy
